monsters.name: Bulette
monsters.description: A seasoned caravan guard learns to listen for the calls of a scout or sentry with a keen ear. One alarm from the scouts that always, always means it's time to pack up, whip your horse and run for the hills? 'LAND SHARK!'

monsters.name: Chimera
monsters.description: Well-known and categorized, the chimera is a perfected creature. Two parts lioness, one part serpent, head of a she-goat, and all the vicious magic one can muster. Used as a guardian, an assassin or merely an instrument of chaos unchained, it matters little. The chimera is the worst sort of abomination: an intentional affront to all natural life.

monsters.name: Derro
monsters.description: It's typical to think that all the malignant arcane monsters made in this world are birthed by wizards, sorcerers, and their ilk. These ones, the derro, are the mistakes of a long-forgotten dwarven alchemist. Twisted and hateful, the derro can be spotted by their swollen skulls, brain-matter grown too large. They do not speak except in thoughts to one another and plot in the silent dark to extract sweetest revenge—that of the created on the creator.
moves: Fill a mind with foreign thoughts
Take control of a beast's mind

monsters.name: Digester
monsters.description: Magical experimentation is a messy science. For every beautiful pegasus there's a half-done creature that wasn't quite right. Point the Digester at it and all your troubles drain away.

monsters.name: Ethereal Filcher
monsters.description: Things go missing. A sock, a silver spoon, your dead mother's bones. We blame the maid, or bad luck. We never see the real cause: the spidery thing with human hands and eyes as blue as the deep Ethereal plane from whence the creature comes, nesting astral silver webbing and stolen objects arranged in some mad pattern.
moves: Take something important to its planar lair
Use an item from its lair

monsters.name: Ettin
monsters.description: What could possibly be better than an idiotic angry hill giant? One with two heads. Fantastic idea, really. Grade A stuff.

monsters.name: Girallon
monsters.description: The pounding of the jungle drums calls to it. The slab of meat on the sacrificial stone to lure in the great ape. Girallon, they call it—taller than a building, some say, cloaked in ivory fur with tusks as long as scimitars.

monsters.name: Iron Golem
monsters.description: A staple of the enchanter's art. Iron is a misnomer, though—these guardians are crafted of any metal, really: steel, copper, or even gold. Unceasing watchdog, stalwart defender, the iron golem lives to serve, following its orders eternally.
moves: Use a special tool or adaptation, built-in

monsters.name: Flesh Golem
monsters.description: Stolen bits and pieces in the night. Graveyards stealthily uprooted and maybe tonight an arm, a leg, another head (the last one came apart too soon). Even the humblest hedge-enchanter can make do with what he can.

monsters.name: Kraken
monsters.description: The Hungerer in the Deep—a mighty squid with tentacles thicker 'round than a barrel and eyes the size of the full moon. Smart, too. Knows just when to strike—when you're all too drunk or too tired or run out of clean water, that's when he gets you.
moves: Drag a person or ship to a watery grave

monsters.name: Manticore
monsters.description: If the chimera is the first step down a dark path, the manticore is a door that can't be closed once it's been opened. A lion, a scorpion, the wings of a drake, and the hissing hateful face of a human married to the creature with twisted magic. All sense of who they are is lost, but the beast is born from human suffering.

monsters.name: Owlbear
monsters.description: Body of a bear. Feathers of an owl. Beak, claws, and excellent night vision. What's not to love?

monsters.name: Pegasus
monsters.description: A fine white horse with the wings of a swan. The elves work miracles, in their own way. They breed true—that's the purity of elf-magic at work. Hatching from little crystal eggs and bonded with their riders for life.
moves: Carry a rider into the air

monsters.name: Rust Monster
monsters.description: Something like a reddish cricket. Blind, feeling their way around with long moth-looking tendrils. Sift through piles of metal for the choicest bits—their merest touch turns it all to rusted flakes.

monsters.name: Xorn
monsters.description: Dwarf-made elemental garbage muncher. Shaped like a trash bin with a radius of arms to feed excess rock and stone into its gaping maw. They eat stone and excrete light and heat. Perfect for operating a mine, until one gets lost in the sewers below a city.
moves: Give off a burst of light and heat
